evidence: Touches Cap'n Proto mining definition (src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp), interfaces::Mining (src/interfaces/mining.h), and functional IPC mining tests (test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py).
rationale: Resolves a data race on `m_block_template` between concurrent IPC worker threads when modifying and reading active templates (issue #36515). Protecting the template with a mutex and adding `getTotalFees()` directly supports the reliability and efficiency of external consumers using the node over IPC.
